parent_objective: audit artifact-only target consolidation before choosing synthesis, scenario-quality route, repair-plan design, or stop
blocked_by: M2449 target and guardrail rows require audit before any synthesis, scenario-quality, or repair-plan route
target rows must not become profile, pack, family, checkpoint, or controller rankings
supersedes: ranking profiles, packs, families, selected checkpoints, or controller families from target rows

public_gates: M2450 must audit M2449 target, guardrail, diagnostic, decision, and summary artifacts
M2450 must decide whether M2449 supports synthesis, scenario-quality route, repair-plan design, stop, or another bounded route
M2450 must preserve profile/pack/family/checkpoint axes as diagnostic-only and non-ranking
M2450 must not rerun rollout, repair, train, rank, select winners, or make paper/current-sim/self-ID verdict claims
forbidden_shortcuts: do not rerun measured policy rollout
do not inject hidden or oracle actor features
do not rank target rows as winners
do not claim actual success improvement
do not claim finite-window vs GRU conclusion
do not claim scenario redesign executed
do not claim training repair success

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: audits whether M2449 compact target and guardrail artifacts support a bounded next route
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: target-consolidation result audit only; no rerun, repair, training, ranking, winner selection, paper verdict, finite-window-vs-GRU, level3 self-ID, scenario-redesign-executed, training-repair, or current-sim verdict claim
stop_condition: stop if target consolidation is too broad or non-actionable
stop if diagnostic axes would be misused as rankings
stop if no bounded next route is supported
fallback_plan: route to branch synthesis if target rows summarize a broad task-quality blocker
route to scenario-quality or repair-plan design only if guardrails are explicit
stop for user review if no bounded route is supported

allowed_updates: M2450 status queue scoreboard research log and review
one follow-up manifest selected by the audit
next_stage_criteria: M2449 consolidation is accepted or rejected
a bounded non-ranking next route is selected or the route is stopped

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: M2450 audits task-quality target consolidation and does not test history necessity.
history_necessity_tests: None in M2450; no wrong-history reset-hidden zero-history finite-window or GRU verdict is run.
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: If target rows show broad task-quality blocker, synthesize or stop before repair/training.
allowed_claims: no controller ranking, candidate-family ranking, paper-level result, finite-window-vs-GRU result, scenario-redesign-executed result, training-repair result, current-sim verdict, or level3 self-identification claim

local_search_guard.evidence_expansion: audits compact target and guardrail artifacts before choosing next branch
local_search_guard.paper_verdict_delta: can decide whether to synthesize the task-quality blocker or design a guarded next route
must_synthesize_if: audit cannot choose a bounded route
diagnostic axes are treated as ranking

hypothesis: Auditing M2449 can decide whether compact target and guardrail artifacts support synthesis, scenario-quality route, repair-plan design, stop, or another bounded route without rerun, repair, training, ranking, or verdict claims.
success_criteria: M2449 summary, target rows, guardrail rows, diagnostic rows, and decision rows are audited
a bounded non-ranking next route is selected or the route is stopped
no rerun repair training ranking winner or verdict claim is made
failure_criteria: M2450 reruns measured validation or policy action
M2450 ranks candidate families, controller families, selected checkpoints, or target rows as winners
M2450 makes current-sim, paper, FW-vs-GRU, self-ID, scenario-redesign, or training-repair verdict claims
decision_rule: M2450 passes if it audits M2449 and selects a bounded non-ranking next route or stops without rerun, repair, training, ranking, winner selection, or verdict claims.
